about: Which agent to suggest for each kind of step. One Roof reads this file to route plan steps; edit the order to match the agents and subscriptions you have. Each list is tried top to bottom; seats above skip_above (percent of their usage window) are passed over.

kind_descriptions.research: Reading, investigating, comparing options, finding out how something works
kind_descriptions.design: Choosing an approach, data model, interface or plan before building
kind_descriptions.code: Writing or changing code: a feature or a bug fix
kind_descriptions.review: Checking a change someone else made
kind_descriptions.test: Writing or running tests, reproducing a failure
kind_descriptions.docs: Writing documentation, guides, READMEs, release notes
kind_descriptions.chore: Housekeeping: upgrades, renames, cleanup, dependency bumps
